The publication-disabled simulated-Actions build-core run and independent native-local build-core run reproduced the package, resolver metadata, both ABI artifacts, and both build logs byte for byte. Both fresh runs independently pass the maintained schema-v2 E2E validator and fail-closed Genesis Plus GX Wide proof.

The pristine fork source is commit 29d9d104338f46bc2e65438fb207bcf54f701e92, tree 27e05ed457d9c10e51b6c69067e1c05599df08fb, with no submodules. The proof binds native leading-space version ` 29d9d10` to all 106 C compile commands per ABI, every source/object and complete compiler invocation, the ordered build phases and exact link, and binary version v1.7.4 29d9d10. ARM64 retains exactly two reviewed warnings and one note; ARMHF is warning- and note-free.

Resolver metadata reports Non-commercial licensing, MS/GG/MD/CD content, twelve optional firmware files, core_options_version 1.0, full-path loading, disk control, deterministic save states, and libretro saves. The candidate source exposes settings under the distinct genesis_plus_gx_wide_* namespace and includes configurable H40 extra columns/translucency plus additional opt-in renderer and audio behavior; Base-core option values therefore do not establish Wide behavior. Widescreen geometry and per-game coverage, firmware/CD/BRAM handling, option defaults and migration, controls, pacing, saves, states, frontend integration, and sustained performance remain target-runtime gates.

Spruce currently ships only an ARM64 Genesis Plus GX Wide binary; its SHA-256 differs from the candidate and it embeds state signature GENPLUS-GX 1.7.6, while the candidate embeds GENPLUS-GX 1.7.7. ARMHF is not shipped. Although candidate source contains a legacy-state load fallback, no state has been round-tripped in either direction. Wide is a separate fork/source line, not a build-flag variant of Base; Base-to-Wide, Wide-to-Base, old-Wide-to-candidate, and candidate-to-old-Wide compatibility are unproven, so no in-place upgrade or cross-variant claim is made.

Resolver metadata declares Non-commercial, while the root license prohibits sale or commercial activity, requires complete corresponding source for modified distributions, and includes separately licensed bundled components. The package contains neither corresponding source nor a license and notice inventory, so any public distribution or release remains a human legal and policy gate even though the local bytes reproduce.

Both builds clone the exact source over the network; no offline source bundle or network-disabled rebuild is proven. The portable toolchain archives and loaded image identities are locked, but cached images retain dockerfile_linkage=unverified-local-cache as an explicit provenance limitation.

ARM64 requires GLIBC_2.17 and records the AArch64 loader and libc. ARMHF is EABI5 hard-float, reaches GLIBC_2.7, and records libc and libm. Provider compatibility is unverified. The portable artifacts bind only to ra64-universal-v1 and ra32-a30-v1; they do not establish ra32-universal-v0, Miyoo Mini, or Pixel 2 compatibility, and all device views remain ineligible pending provider and target-runtime evidence. Spruce exposes the Wide selector only for TRIMUI_SMART_PRO and TRIMUI_SMART_PRO_S in 16:9 mode; prioritize those two ra64-universal-v1 targets for load/play/save/state/geometry capture.
